actions_not_taken: no production or device or NAS operations
backup unit tests were read but not executed

local_evidence.nas_rsync_version: not read; no login to prnas

minimal_implementation: Publish by same-filesystem directory rename of payload.sqlite3 plus manifest.json after fsync.
archive_id is internal [0-9a-f]{32}; receipt accepts id, sha256, bytes, record_count only.
Count the ten analytics tables on the backup connection before close. SHA256 is of the transferred file. No gzip layer in this slice.
Receipt is one conditional update. Identical retry succeeds and deletes nothing. Mismatch leaves state unchanged.
Pin published-but-unverified packages outside --keep 2. Do not lower keep to 1. Do not change capacity.ts multiplier 4.
If an unverified full backup already exists, skip the next full backup and delete nothing. 300 seconds is not a full-backup interval.
NAS pull uses relative --partial-dir=.rsync-partial and explicit --no-whole-file. Do not use --append, --append-verify, absolute partial-dir, -W, or --delete.
Do not reuse analytics-offsite-pull.py; it copies .env.analytics and deletes by age.
Shell keeps analytics-maintenance.lock. analytics-backup.py takes a separate analytics-backup.lock and only then sweeps its own partial names.
Move the 60s, 90s, and systemd 120s budgets together, cap at 2h, set Restart=no. A 100MiB run does not close the mature-database timeout item.
Ack is a fixed argv program. Send it only after file and directory fsync. Leave stored archive_enabled false.

rsync.reason: append-verify is for shared growing files, conflicts with the partial-dir/inplace family, skips receivers that are not shorter than the source, and is absent from this host's openrsync. Local-to-local rsync implies --whole-file and deletes partial-dir data. Absolute partial-dir has an upstream false-verification loop (RsyncProject/rsync 31fbb17) that this review did not reproduce.

ack_loss.after_nas_fsync_and_rename: cloud stays published, file remains, next pull sends receipt only

sqlite_and_cleanup.api: existing sqlite3 backup API, mode=ro URI, inode-checked partial unlink

likely_missed_tests: second transfer literal bytes much smaller than 100MiB after kill past about 40MiB
reject local-path rsync and -W as resume evidence
corrupt prefix shorter, equal length, and longer than source; published id absent
manifest record_count altered while bytes stay the same
counts taken on the backup connection, recomputed after isolated restore
ack dropped after fsync; no full retransfer; inode unchanged; duplicate ack does not delete
kill between sqlite rename and manifest; keep must not evict the previous manifested backup
SIGKILL partial swept only while analytics-backup.lock is held and only for the tool's own names
two direct analytics-backup.py processes; loser is busy
unverified package suppresses the next full backup; 300s must not mean a full backup
slow progress past 60s retains previous final backup; systemd 120s updated with the other two limits
failed isolated restore does not shrink 7 daily or 4 weekly; last verified copy remains; weekly is not a symlink
committed WAL row present without a checkpoint
harness aborts when resolved paths are under /opt/p003/server
archive_enabled true still invalid; capacity multiplier still 4
